description: Overhead cymbal preset. Airy presence with tube shimmer, kick bleed removed. Keeps its own stereo image.
name: overhead-shine
notes: Precondition: Overhead track selected in Cubase, inserts 0-1 loaded per opencode/reference/overhead-shine.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Air shelf / low-cut are manual by resolved title (same-slot duplicate Gain would overwrite).
Send slot 0 -> short ambience FX, kept low (assign destination in Cubase one-time setup).
